newsitem.title: CANADA: Merged Abitibi chooses Montreal head office.
newsitem.headline: Merged Abitibi chooses Montreal head office.

text.p: Abitibi-Price Inc and Stone-Consolidated Corp said on Monday that the head office for the merged company will be located in Montreal.

A committee of six executives from the two companies uanimously chose Montreal for several reasons. It is the executive center of the forest products industry in eastern Canada, offering a critical mass of qualified talent and sectorial expertise in the pulp and paper industry, more than any other city in North America, the companies said.
Operating costs for head offices in Montreal are generally 10 percent less than Toronto, they said.

In addition to the cluster effect of the forest products industry in Montreal and its proximity to the merged company's 24 North American operations, the city also offers the multi-cultural platform to meet Abitibi-Consolidated's future growth aspirations, the companies said.

"Both the Ontario and Quebec governments put forward positive cases on behalf of the two cities. Naturally, we are aware of the political sensitivities that attend any head office decision," said Abitibi-Price chairman and chief execurtive officer Ron Oberlander in a statement.
The decision was a politically sensitive one in Quebec because Montreal has lost dozens of large company head offices to Toronto and other Canadian cities over the past 20 years.
